name: Drush Endpoint
description: An HTTP endpoint (POST /api/drush/{command}) that runs a small allowlist of Drush commands during automated testing. Pre-release: 1.0.0-rc1.
project_description: Drush Endpoint exposes a short allowlist of Drush commands over an HTTP POST endpoint (`/api/drush/{command}`) so an automated test suite (for example Cypress) can trigger them when the test runner cannot call Drush directly — e.g. the test container is separate from the web container. It is a testing-only tool: the endpoint stays inert until a settings flag is set, the module ships no admin UI and no permissions, and the maintainer's own documentation states it must never be enabled on production. This version dir documents the pre-release 1.0.0-rc1. Maintained by Bill Seremetis (bserem).
